facts.fact: 战后当夜没有庆功宴：孩子们打完仗仍兴奋难眠，多数人身上带血，被劝先去洗
火堆边只剩四人加远处吹萨克斯的 Tito，Tinker Bell 复述船上经过与 Giovanni 的出手
facts.anchor: Tinker Bell has explained what happened on the ship, how Hook trapped her, and Giovanni’s attack.

facts.fact: Tinker Bell 把船上的失败揽到自己头上，Peter 当场答「没错」
Tinker Bell 的史观：19 与 20 世纪之交，魔法按「肉身历」退走
facts.anchor: by the calendar of Flesh, Enchantment moved away

facts.fact: Luisa 为 Giovanni 舍掉精灵的长寿，宁可只过一世凡人的日子
facts.anchor: she didn’t wish for even a year without her man

facts.fact: 叙述点明 Luisa 的本相是精灵，做人只是为爱改装
facts.anchor: her original nature was that of a fairy

facts.fact: Giovanni 一夜未眠，脑内分裂成控告者与辩护者两造互相审讯
facts.anchor: His mind has been split in two, the Accuser and the Defender.

facts.fact: Augusto 在船长舱的早餐桌上告知：Luisa 不属于人类
facts.anchor: Luisa wasn’t human, my dear boy.

facts.fact: Augusto 把 Peter 定义成潘神：rape 与无节制享乐之神，如今回来要给同类开路
facts.anchor: Pan, the god of rape and wanton pleasure, devoid of control

facts.fact: Giovanni 问制服找谁领，等于当场投向海盗一方
facts.anchor: Who do I need to talk to about a uniform?

facts.fact: Giada 引 Plutarch：潘神随基督降世而死，其形象后来被基督教塑成撒旦
facts.anchor: wrote that Pan died with the advent of Christ

facts.fact: 叙述回溯阿卡迪亚牧人在正午见影子缩短就发抖，怕潘神显形
facts.anchor: Once the shepherds of Arcadia, seeing their shadows shorten as this hour approached

facts.fact: Peter 宣布离岛返罗马、去适应新时代，防御工事交给两个「将军」
facts.anchor: I must return to Rome, understand the new age.

facts.fact: 裸身的 Tinker Bell 显出雌雄莫辨的形体，并声称可随对方所好变男变女
Wendy 在树与水之间看 Giada，觉得眼前这一刻是神圣的
facts.anchor: This, she thinks, is truly sacred.

facts.fact: 章末点题：两人飞起来靠的就是仙尘，与方才的高潮同源
facts.anchor: “Fairy dust,” she says. “What did you think it was?”
